result.question: What does the old prophet do with the body?

readings.answer: He lifts it, puts it on a donkey, brings it back to his city to mourn and bury him, and lays it in his own tomb.
readings.support: lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him | Then he laid the body in his own tomb,

assessments.reason: It explicitly says he laid the body in his own tomb after bringing it back, which is the same as burying him in his grave.

result.reason: The passage states the old prophet laid the body in his own tomb, i.e., buried him in his grave.
